# Tauri Concept — Tauri v2 architecture, process model and IPC isolation patterns

Curated by Skill Harbor — @full-stack-skills' tauri-concept: a Tauri v2 agent skill covering architecture concepts — the core process vs WebView process separation, the process model, IPC isolation options, and brownfield integration patterns.
